boxes.meaning: be a burden to, drag down

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone or something is burdened by being held back or encumbered.
Use this as the all-purpose everyday choice when a burden weighs someone or something down or makes it harder to act.

examples.english: Don't burden me all the time—let me walk by myself.
examples.traditional: 你唔好成日拖累我，畀我自己行啦。
examples.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 to1 leoi6 ngo5 bei2 ngo5 zi6 gei2 haang4 laa1

examples.english: This pile of luggage can encumber us, making us tired after a few steps.
examples.traditional: 呢堆行李真係拖累我哋，行幾步就攰。
examples.jyutping: ne1 deoi1 hang4 lei5 zan1 hai6 to1 leoi6 ngo5 dei6 haang4 gei2 bou6 zau6 gui6
